title: Working with Strings

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Working with Strings** as part of **Strings, Arrays, and Collections**. String operations return values that should be handled explicitly; choose templates for interpolation and regular expressions only when pattern matching is the right abstraction. Use the subtopics—Creating and Comparing Strings, String Length and Character Access, String Immutability—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Functions, null safety, strings, and collections are the building blocks of most practical Kotlin code. Choosing the right operation reduces avoidable errors and makes behavior easier to test.
